marketing_wrapper: Heavy. No device frames. 01 is a hero render of a green-and-orange 3D toy camera over a dark grid of camera parts with ADA and 15,000+ review laurels. 02 is a full-bleed sample photo (SuperRAW) with a badge. 03 shows the colourway picker (real UI: segment labels and glossy colour spheres) beneath a rendered camera. 04 and 05 show the viewfinder region of the app cropped tight, with a caption and a feature legend. 06 is a macro close-up of the 3D control deck. The real UI is visible in fragments in 03-06, never as a whole screen.

typography.display: Custom: a heavy geometric grotesk for in-app labels ('Lens', 'Top', 'Buttons', 'Cinematic') and the 'A' auto button; marketing captions use a similar grotesk plus an italic serif 'from' (unsure of names).
typography.numerals: mono: the focus dial and feature legend use a monospaced all-caps face ('MACRO', '.02m', 'EXPOSURE', 'SHUTTER SPEED')
typography.weights: Heavy/bold for segment labels; regular mono for technical labels.
typography.case_and_tracking: All-caps tracked mono for technical readouts; title case for picker segments.

palette.accent_strategy: User-authored colourway: the camera body, lens ring and buttons take colours the user picks from 17 glossy swatches plus a custom wheel. Feature icons use a fixed multi-colour set (yellow exposure, blue shutter, red white balance, teal focus, purple histogram). Default control accents are yellow-orange (flash toggle, focus ring gradient).
palette.source: palette.json 01, 05, 06 (#191919, #2a2a2a, #1f221e dark plastic body, #000000 viewfinder surround); accent hexes are visual estimates (flash toggle yellow, focus ring orange, 04 purple dial)

shape.radius_language: large and physical: chunky rounded-rect deck with about 40 pt corners, circular buttons, pill toggle, knurled cylinder dials; viewfinder about 12 pt
shape.concentric: yes: buttons and toggle sit in recessed wells that follow the deck's corner
shape.borders_shadows: Real-time 3D shading: recessed wells with inner shadows, cast shadows from knobs, specular highlights on glossy swatches and dials.
shape.materials: Rendered 3D plastic and rubber (matte black deck, knurled dials, glossy toggles); textured concrete in the backdrop.

liquid_glass_visible: no: everything is a custom 3D render; no system bars visible
density: low on the main shooting surface (a few oversized controls around the viewfinder); medium in the colour picker grid
layout: Main: a viewfinder window set into a dark 3D camera body, with a flash toggle, a vertical knurled scroll wheel, a settings button and an 'A' (auto) button in the deck, and a purple knurled dial above. Manual focus: an orange-yellow knurled focus ring around the circular viewfinder with a mono 'MACRO' arc scale from .02m to infinity. Customise: rendered camera on top, a horizontal text segment (Body, Top, Lens, Buttons), and a grid of glossy colour spheres.
navigation: Fully custom: no tab bar or nav bar in view. Controls are physical: toggle, scroll wheel, dials, round buttons; style selection by a tick-marked carousel ('Cinematic').
imagery_and_icons: 3D rendered camera and controls; a custom flat geometric icon set for features (multi-colour, filled); hexagon badges for LUT and style; sample photography.
signature_visual_move: The whole UI is a lit 3D camera body: a knurled focus ring wraps the viewfinder and a chunky flash toggle and scroll wheel sit in recessed wells.

direction_fit.why: Physically lit 3D controls and user colourways are the toy layer; the mono technical scale, focus peaking, zebras and histogram are the instrument layer underneath, exactly as the text record's mixed tag says.

notes: No whole-screen capture exists in the set, so layout is pieced together from crops. The typography confirms one fact the text record lacked: technical readouts use a monospaced all-caps face.
